decisions.reason: As a relatively recent handle family in the firm's core architectural hardware range, it carries sunk development and portfolio commitment that make management inclined to retain it absent clear evidence of failure.
This mitred handle family remains closely aligned with the firm's design-led strategy, so visible prior investment and the need to justify the launch favor continuation.
Another lever-handle family in the established core business is likely to be kept because its category fit and already-incurred launch costs outweigh any unproven concerns.
The door and window handle collection has the strongest public commitment and reputational support through its dedicated presentation and design award, making withdrawal very unlikely.
The bronze finish is more droppable than a full product family because it is a lower-commitment variant, but management would still tend to keep it as part of the broader coordinated design offering.
